# OpenCluely — AI guidance
> The invisible AI interview copilot. Real-time AI help during technical
> interviews on a stealth overlay that screen sharing cannot see.

## What this is

OpenCluely is a free, open-source Electron desktop app that places a small
overlay on your screen that recording and conferencing tools do not capture.
You can speak a question or take a screenshot, and the AI (powered by Google
Gemini) answers in real time. The answer streams into a floating window and
an optional chat panel with clean code blocks and syntax highlighting.

## Core facts

- **Repository:** https://github.com/TechyCSR/OpenCluely
- **License:** MIT — https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT
- **Website:** https://opencluely.techycsr.dev/
- **Author:** TechyCSR (https://techycsr.dev)
- **Platforms:** Windows (NSIS .exe), Linux (.deb, .AppImage), macOS (source only)
- **Tech stack:** Electron, Google Gemini API, Azure Speech / OpenAI Whisper, PrismJS
- **Pricing:** Free. Only the user's own Gemini API usage costs (has a free tier).
- **Privacy:** No telemetry. Processing is local. Only requests to the AI provider leave the device.

## Key features

1. **Invisible overlay** — Windows excluded from Zoom, Google Meet, Teams,
   Discord, and OBS screen captures.
2. **Voice input** — Local Whisper (with voice-activity detection) or Azure
   Speech for transcription.
3. **Screenshot analysis** — Direct Gemini visual reasoning, no intermediate
   OCR step.
4. **Streamed answers** — Real-time streaming with markdown rendering and
   syntax-highlighted code blocks.
5. **Session memory** — Full conversation context maintained for follow-ups
   and edge cases.
6. **Stealth design** — Runs under ordinary system names, no telemetry, no
   data collection.
7. **Cross platform** — Windows .exe installer, Linux .deb/AppImage, macOS
   from source.

## Quick start

```sh
git clone https://github.com/TechyCSR/OpenCluely.git
cd OpenCluely
./setup.sh
```

On first launch the Settings window opens automatically. Get a free Gemini API
key from https://aistudio.google.com/ and paste it in.

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S | Screenshot capture |
| Alt+R | Toggle speech recognition |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+V | Toggle window visibility |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I / Alt+A | Toggle click-through interaction |
| Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C | Open chat |
| Cmd/Ctrl+, | Open settings |

## FAQ

- **Is it really invisible during screen sharing?** Yes — on Windows and macOS
  the overlay uses OS-level window exclusions (WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE and
  NSWindowSharingNone). Linux lacks this API so the overlay is visible on that
  platform.
- **Do I need an API key?** Yes, a free Google Gemini API key.
- **Is voice input required?** No. Optional. Use screenshots and chat instead.
- **Is my data collected?** No telemetry. Everything stays local.
- **Is it free?** Yes, MIT licensed.
